_README: Sponsor credit in the banner. While enabled is false nothing renders. To go live: set enabled to true and fill name, plus url and logo if there are any. logo is a file in public/ (e.g. "sponsor-acme.png") or an https URL; logos sit on a white chip, so art drawn for white works. The line above the name ("Presented by") is sponsor.presentedBy in src/strings/. The link is marked rel=sponsored and carries UTM tags. Keep the credit in the banner; never place it among the figures.
